public_rationale: Zitron estimated Anthropic's 2026 revenue at around $40 billion, assuming it grows faster than OpenAI. The year has not ended. Anthropic's S-1 confirms his first-half base of about $16.3 billion. CNBC reports Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion, putting revenue through September at about $33.1 billion. If Q4 is anywhere near Q3, the full year would land around $50 billion, above his estimate. That points against the figure, but it is a projection. Cumulative reported revenue has not yet passed a level that would rule out 'around $40 billion' under my reading. Full-year 2026 revenue will settle it.
limitations: The tolerance for 'around $40 billion' is my reading, not his.
The Q3 dollar figure comes from a news report citing unnamed people. The S-1 gives Q3 only as a multiple of Q4 2024.
The growth premise has not been checked against OpenAI figures.

statement.excerpt: Through the first half of 2026, Anthropic had around $16.3 billion in revenue, and if we assume that it’s growing faster than OpenAI, that puts its annual revenue around $40 billion for 2026.

from_speaker: "Through the first half of 2026, Anthropic had around $16.3 billion in revenue"
"if we assume that it's growing faster than OpenAI"
"that puts its annual revenue around $40 billion"
our_interpretation: The forecast is Anthropic's realized revenue for calendar 2026, as Anthropic reports it.

'Around $40 billion' is read in the ordinary loose sense. A result in the mid-to-high $30 billions or low $40 billions fits. A result far outside that, such as above about $48 billion or below about $33 billion, would not. This band is my reading; he gave none.

The premise 'growing faster than OpenAI' is a modeling assumption he states. Its natural test is that Anthropic's 2026 revenue growth rate beats OpenAI's. The check would use full-year figures if available, and otherwise the latest comparable period.
The first-half figure of $16.3 billion is a historical part. Anthropic's S-1 confirms it, but it does not settle the full-year forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Anthropic's reported 2026 calendar-year revenue comes in around $40 billion, in the ordinary sense above, and Anthropic grew faster than OpenAI in 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Anthropic grew faster than OpenAI, but its reported 2026 revenue is clearly not around $40 billion: well above it (about $48 billion or more) or well below it.
